purpose: Executable structural dynamic core constrained by the accounting spine; behavioural closure remains inactive until mechanisms pass explicit empirical and identifiability gates.

time.rationale: Quarterly is the preferred empirical frequency where definitions remain compatible; smaller dt values are used for integration-error tests.

stocks.meaning: Financial asset of holder and equal financial liability of issuer represented once.
Reusable first-order delay state; concrete mechanism assignment requires explicit later documentation.

flows.source_relation: Observed period transaction amount / period length in years when a rate representation is required. The transformation must be recorded.

auxiliaries.definition: sum of bilateral positions where sector is holder
sum of bilateral positions where sector is issuer
sum of sector net financial worth over H/C/F/G/X/BNR; must equal zero up to numerical tolerance for a complete represented financial boundary
numerator / denominator, undefined rather than forced when denominator is zero

integration.reason: transparent reference integrator for structural tests; later validated simulation may add another integrator only with equivalence/error tests

time_step_rule.scope: reference structural simulation and any later active first-order delay using explicit Euler
time_step_rule.rationale: Prevent coarse-step oscillation or qualitative distortion and require a conservative step relative to the shortest active time constant.
time_step_rule.activation_requirement: Every active delay must have a finite positive tau and pass the dt/tau gate plus time-step halving sensitivity before reference-model activation.

empirical_initialization_gate.rule: Incomplete benchmark matrices with TBD cells cannot initialize a numeric dynamic state. Missing data must never become simulation zero implicitly.

behavioural_closure.rule: Behavioural mechanisms may enter the reference simulation only with explicit scientific status, observed or defensibly estimated parameters, and passed empirical/identifiability gates.
